tokens.name: kalk
tokens.usage: Page background (chalk). A cool, slightly green off-white; never pure white as a page.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Cards and panels that must lift off kalk: clinic cards, price lists, inputs. Always with a 1px line border, never a shadow.

tokens.name: siv
tokens.usage: Tinted panel (reed green) for the Brøndby clinic card, treatment-group sections and image placeholders. Text on it is tang or tang-muted (4.8:1).

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Warm tinted panel for the baby & child section, the Nykøbing clinic card and the footer band. Text on it is tang, tang-muted or rav-deep.

tokens.name: tang
tokens.usage: Ink: all headlines, body text, icons, the mark's strokes and primary buttons. Deep seaweed green, used where another brand would use black. 10.7:1 on kalk.

tokens.name: tang-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: addresses, opening days, captions and eyebrows on kalk, bone, siv and sand. 5.7:1 on kalk, 4.8:1 on siv.

tokens.name: tang-subtle
tokens.usage: Metadata at 14px and up only (dates, footnotes) on kalk and bone. 5.0:1 on kalk. Never body copy.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: card borders, price-list row dividers, input borders at rest, the header rule. Decorative, not a meaning-carrying contrast.

tokens.name: rav
tokens.usage: The accent (amber). Fills only: the one 'Book tid' button per view, the touchpoint dot in the mark and eyebrows, a highlight behind a short phrase. Never as text and never as a thin line; 1.9:1 on kalk.

tokens.name: on-rav
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a rav fill. Always tang (5.5:1).

tokens.name: rav-deep
tokens.usage: Amber as text or underline: inline links, the current nav item, the price in a price row. 5.1:1 on kalk, 4.6:1 on sand. Not on siv (4.3:1).

tokens.name: on-tang
tokens.usage: Text on a tang fill: primary button labels, the reversed lockup, footer text. 10.7:1.

tokens.name: on-tang-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on a tang fill: footer addresses, captions on dark panels. 6.9:1.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Form validation errors and the 'closed today' note only. 5.9:1 on kalk. Never decorative.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element on kalk, bone, siv and sand. On a tang panel the ring is rav.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Rolige hænder til små og store kroppe
styles.usage: The hero headline. One per page, sentence case, two to three lines, max 14 words. 44px on phones.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section headlines. Sentence case. 32px on phones.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Clinic names on cards, treatment-group titles, the about-page intro.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and list headings in sentence case. The weight of 'Hertzum' in the wordmark.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: The amount in a price row. Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums), colour rav-deep on kalk/bone/sand.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Anne Hertzum er autoriseret osteopat og fysioterapeut og behandler babyer, børn og voksne.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a display headline. Max 65 characters per line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Osteopati kan hjælpe ved fx kolik, stramt tungebånd, hold i ryggen og bækkensmerter.
styles.usage: Default running text everywhere. 65 characters measure, tang on kalk or bone.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: Alle tider er inkl. omklædning og journalføring.
styles.usage: Card body copy, price-list notes, footnotes. tang-muted is fine here.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: Vi gør os umage for at du skal blive smertefri.
styles.usage: Pull quotes and the one italic moment per page. Never for body copy.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a headline or card title, preceded by the rav touchpoint dot. Colour tang-muted (or on-tang-muted on tang).

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels. Sentence case, never uppercase, verb first.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Addresses, opening days, phone numbers and navigation links. Colour tang-muted; tang when it is a link.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between the touchpoint dot and an eyebrow label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an eyebrow and its headline; between icon and label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between two buttons; between price-list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a headline and its lead paragraph; phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between a section's headline block and its content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side margin at 1280 and up.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop; hero top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags and the small logo tile at favicon size.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Cards, price lists, images and the mark's tile. The default corner.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Hero image and the large tinted section panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and the touchpoint dot. Every button is a pill.

border.note: Surfaces are separated by tint and one hairline, never by shadow.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Every border in the system, in colour line. There is no thick border.

shadow.note: One shadow, for the sticky mobile booking bar only.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The sticky 'Book tid' bar on phones and nothing else. Cards never cast a shadow.
